title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centers, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.


Title- Sr .Net SQL Developer

Location- Brazil (Remote)

Type of Hire- Full Time


Senior Developer (.NET/SQL server/AWS)

  • Good in communication and client interaction
  • 10+ years of experience in .NET technologies: .NET core MVC, C#, Entity Framework, Web API, Java Script, jQuery, Bootstrap, SSIS, Kendo, AWS
  • Knowledge on SSIS and Kendo is preferred.
  • Good working experience on DB – SQL and SQL server (Data analysis, writing complex queries, Stored procedures).
  • Good working experience in AWS cloud (like S3, RDS, Lamda, gateway, SQS) is preferred.
  • Participate in all the Scrum Ceremonies (Daily scrum, spring planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives)
  • Requirement gathering and analysis.
  • Story estimations and analysis
  • Performing UI and DB design
  • Coding and unit testing
  • UAT and production bug fixes
  • Deployment of code to Dev/STG
  • Participate in release calls and resolve the issues found.
  • Production support and resolve the issues found.
  • Performing Daily/weekly production monitoring jobs
  • Supporting the associate developers (requirement gathering, analysis, coding, testing and production support)
  • Daily Project Health monitoring.
  • Mortgage / Finance domain experience is a plus.
  • Experience in working with large applications with large volume transactions is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and unit testing activities
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP).
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Knowledge of design patterns, refactoring, and unit testing
  • Experience with Linux and open-source software is a plus.
  • AWS Environment - EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, Containers, API Gateway experience highly preferred
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and QA activities (highly preferred)


Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Contract Duration: 6 to 12 months

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor / Contract

Work Model: Nearshore – Remote

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST)


About the Opportunity

We are a staffing and recruitment consultancy supporting one of our clients with a long-term project. We are seeking a Scrum Master to join a Product & Engineering environment, supporting one to two Scrum teams and contributing to the continuous improvement of Agile practices.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for a professional who is comfortable working with distributed teams and collaborating closely with Agile leadership.


Experience Level

Mid-level (2–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master)


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, ensuring alignment with Agile principles
  • Support and guide one Scrum team, with potential responsibility for a second team
  • Partner with an enterprise Agile Coach to improve team performance and delivery
  • Assist with the implementation and adoption of SAFe practices
  • Identify, escalate, and help remove impediments impacting team progress
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation and feedback
  • Work closely with mid-level managers and cross-functional team members across multiple regions


Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience as a dedicated Scrum Master
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Scrum of Scrums)
  • Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework); certifications are a strong plus
  • Experience working with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations and navigate team conflicts
  • Experience working with distributed, global teams


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities
  • Adaptability, flexibility, and a proactive attitude
  • Ability to challenge ideas constructively and negotiate pushback when needed
  • Independent thinker with a continuous improvement mindset


Education & Certifications

  • SAFe certification is highly desired
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (optional)


Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment
  • Comfortable collaborating with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia
  • Willingness to learn, adapt, and evolve within Agile frameworks

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure:

  • Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).
  • Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).
  • Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.

Security:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.

Automation and Scripting:

  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).

DevOps and Monitoring:

  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.

Data and Analytics:

  • Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads.
  • Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.g., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications.
  • Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.g., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines.

Cloud Architecture:

  • Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.g., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications.
  • API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.g., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs.

title: Account Executive
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.


About Us


Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.


We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.


We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

The Account Executive is responsible for managing the success of client PR campaigns by developing media strategies, conducting targeted outreach, and maintaining regular communication with both clients and media contacts. This role ensures client visibility across national, regional, podcast, radio, and TV platforms, while also contributing to broader brand awareness and engagement. Account Executives are key relationship builders and storytellers who drive results by connecting the right narrative to the right outlet.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute strategic PR plans tailored to each client
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Build, grow, and create new client relationships
  • Conduct media research and Build and update targeted media lists
  • Secure, filter, and respond to media opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate media interviews, ensuring all logistics are handled
  • Follow up with media contacts to confirm placements and coverage timelines
  • Monitor coverage through Google Alerts and track mentions or product features
  • Facilitate writing projects with team in alignment with client goals and deliverables
  • Monitor news trends and identify timely angles for client exposure
  • Provide daily (Monday–Friday) client updates and maintain consistent communication
  • Prepare and send biweekly and monthly reports and lookbooks
  • Maintain updated media trackers to record media coverage and interview status


Results


  • Meet or exceed the expected number of interviews or media features
  • Clients receive timely and proactive communication on campaign progress
  • Media placements align with client goals, increase brand visibility, and credibility
  • Clients recognize value from their engagement with Publicity For Good
  • Accurate and updated documentation of all PR activities and client deliverables


Requirements


  • 40 hours plus per week to meet client needs
  • Proven experience or education in public relations or a related communications field
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficient in Google Suite, Gmail, and media monitoring tools
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first team environment
  • Personable and professional in client and media interactions
  • Able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
  • High level of self-accountability and commitment to delivering results


Remuneration & Rewards


  • Access to internal and external learning opportunities
  • Ongoing performance reviews and career development guidance
  • Clear advancement plan based on both role progression and financial growth
  • Access to a curated library of on-demand professional development content


The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Product Owner– AI-Powered Platform
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;

title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
Network Automation Engineer


We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to design, build, and automate large-scale, carrier-grade network infrastructure. This role blends deep network engineering expertise with modern automation and software development practices. You will work on high-availability internet and backbone networks, translating complex network designs into repeatable, programmatic templates and workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain carrier-grade network infrastructure supporting internet and backbone services
  • Engineer and support Cisco IOS XR–based platforms in production environments
  • Develop and maintain network automation solutions using Python scripting
  • Translate network designs, configurations, and standards into programmatic templates (Jinja2)
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management of network devices
  • Design and support VPN architectures and products, including troubleshooting and optimisation
  • Ensure high availability, resiliency, and performance across large-scale networks
  • Participate in network design reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong background in network engineering and design
  • Hands-on experience with carrier-grade networks and internet infrastructure
  • Deep knowledge of Cisco IOS XR (configuration, troubleshooting, and operations)
  • Solid understanding of VPN technologies and products
  • Python scripting for network automation and tooling
  • Experience creating and managing Jinja2 templates for network configuration

title: PLM Engineer III
description:
PLM Engineer III @ Remote


Job Summary:

In this role, the PLM Engineer III will serve as a technical expert in the areas of infrastructure related to manufacturing information systems. The engineer will identify methods and architect solutions to provide a high level of service to end-users of the application(s). This role will help build out, maintain, and troubleshoot a rapidly expanding application system and its infrastructure. The Engineer will work closely with other engineers, analysts, and leadership to obtain regular feedback on design and execution. Additionally, the Engineer will provide periodic operational support and maintenance of the manufacturing systems.


Essential Duties:

• Responsible for the maintenance, optimization, troubleshooting, upgrades, installation and documentation of infrastructure related to Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems which

includes PLM database management, project management systems, CAD and PDM systems,

• Administration of new and existing technologies, including the design, documentation, install, configuration, maintenance, integration, and testing related systems

• Leads collaboratively with business customers on hardware, middleware, and application requirements.

• Leads with vendors, engineers, analysts, and leadership to ensure the integrity of databases, application software and data

• Performs regular system monitoring, verifying the integrity, health and availability of all systems and key processes, reviewing application and system logs, and ensuring completion of scheduled jobs

• Leads problem-solving efforts regarding system and service matters and if necessary, facilitates support with outside personnel, organizations, and/or vendors

• Monitor tech-industry trends, and brings new ideas and innovative solutions

• Develop new deliverables as needed based on operational requirements and following best practices for documentation and delivery

• Analyzes data to drive decision making and recommendations.

• Configure and deploy devices and peripherals as necessary

• Resolves issues, problems and questions on-site assigned from a ticketing system


Qualifications: Requirements - Required and/or Preferred


Education:

• Basic: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, or similar discipline, and/or equivalent related work experience

• Preferred: PLM Certification


Essential Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with ARAS (PLM tool) and SolidWorks (CAD system)

• Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in a factory or enterprise setting

• Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience with PLM

• Technical expertise with PLM systems such as CAD, PDM, ERP, PMO

• Excellent communication (oral and written) skills, including the ability to explain and present technical information

• Effectively train and advise users on information technology issues

• Prepare written documentation in a clear and concise style

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, flexible environment and take the initiative to learn new tools and concepts quickly

• Creative thinker with attention to detail, strong analytical, multitasking, and interpersonal skills

• Approachable and adaptable

• Ability to work extended-hours or outside of normal business hours including weekends as needed

• Skills in MS Office (Word, Power Point, Excel, Outlook)

• Must have working-level knowledge of the English language, including reading, writing, and speaking English


Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience in a factory environment desirable

• Technical experience with database management & language (SQL, Oracle)

• Able to work independently and in a team environment, as well as with cross-functional groups

• Resilient, self-motived and able to work well under pressure

title: Data Analyst
description:
Descrição da Função


Esta é uma função remota em tempo integral para Analista de Dados . O Analista de Dados será responsável por coletar, organizar, analisar e interpretar grandes conjuntos de dados para identificar padrões e tendências. A coleta ocorrerá em bancos de dados próprios bem como a busca de dados em bases externas, de forma automatizada e também de forma manual (que pode vir a ser automatizada, fazendo parte da função). Também irá desenvolver e manter painéis de dados (dashboards), criar modelos de dados e auxiliar na melhoria dos processos de tomada de decisão do negócio, alimentar e criar planilhas. Além disso, a função inclui a preparação de relatórios e a apresentação clara de insights para as partes interessadas.

Qualificações

  • Proficiência em Análise de Dados e compreensão abrangente do trabalho com grandes volumes de dados
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de identificar tendências e insights acionáveis
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Estatística para analisar dados e gerar conclusões precisas
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para apresentar insights e colaborar com equipes multifuncionais
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados e criação de visualizações eficazes
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e softwares estatísticos como SQL, Python, R é desejável
  • Conhecimento em Excel avançado é necessário
  • Conhecimento básico de Ingles é necessário.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em um ambiente remoto em tempo integral
  • Graduação em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada é altamente desejável

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java e Agentes de IA II
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java com experiência em engenharia de software, mentalidade DevOps e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções com agentes de IA, automação inteligente e integrações com modelos de linguagem (LLMs), no projeto BSS, do ICC SOFT.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e aplicações em Java, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Construir, testar e implantar agentes de IA para automação de processos de negócio;
  • Integrar LLMs com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços externos e ferramentas corporativas;
  • Contribuir para pipelines de RAG, mecanismos de memória e recuperação eficiente de contexto;
  • Garantir a confiabilidade dos fluxos envolvendo agentes de IA e automações inteligentes;
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, integração e funcionais);
  • Escrever testes específicos para componentes agentic AI;
  • Atuar em troubleshooting de ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD para build, teste e deploy contínuo;
  • Utilizar conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes) para implantações;
  • Assegurar observabilidade e monitoramento de workflows agentic AI;
  • Participar de code reviews, sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento e cerimônias ágeis;
  • Prestar suporte técnico e atuar como referência para demandas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Revisar e manter documentação detalhada de arquitetura, componentes, integrações e processos de deploy;
  • Registrar decisões técnicas e padrões adotados para uso de IA e automação.



Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou correlatos;


Experiência em:

  • Desenvolvimento Java e POO,
  • Microsserviços e APIs REST,
  • Automação de testes (unitários, integração ou funcionais),
  • Ferramentas GIT,
  • LLMs e frameworks de IA (ex: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel);


Domínio em Java e Python

  • Node.js ou outra linguagem é diferencial;


Conhecimento em bancos de dados (SQL Server, Oracle, Cassandra ou similares);


Noções de vetores, embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais;


Compreensão de APIs, microservices e conceitos básicos de cloud;


Boa capacidade de depuração, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica;


Inglês em nível avançado/fluente para contato diário com equipes internacionais.



Seria interessante se você tivesse:


Experiência em:

  • Multi-agent systems ou agents com function-calling,
  • TDD ou BDD,
  • Conteinerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes;


Conhecimento em:

  • Grafos e Graph DBs (ex: Neo4j),
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions),
  • Observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK),
  • Telecom (não obrigatório);


Familiaridade com plataformas de cloud.



Informações adicionais


Horário de trabalho : Segunda a sexta, das 08h às 12h e das 13h às 17h.


Local de trabalho: As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de teletrabalho “Home Office”.

title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.

title: UX/UI DESIGN
description:
Olá, somos a ETUS

Somos uma MadTech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.

ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia SaaS e otimização de conversão (CRO).

Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.

Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa UX/UI Design Pleno para atuar com foco em CRO (Otimização de Conversão), desenvolvendo interfaces digitais estratégicas para sites, landing pages e fluxos de conversão. Essa pessoa atuará em parceria direta com o time de CRO, transformando diagnósticos, pesquisas e wireframes em interfaces visuais consistentes, funcionais e orientadas a resultados.

A posição é indicada para quem entende que design vai além da estética e atua como ferramenta de clareza, impacto visual e performance de negócio.


Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

● Criar layouts de alta fidelidade para sites, landing pages e fluxos digitais, com foco em conversão.

● Transformar wireframes de baixa fidelidade em interfaces visuais bem resolvidas, consistentes e alinhadas ao posicionamento das marcas.

● Trabalhar em parceria direta com Estrategistas de CRO, recebendo diagnósticos, pesquisas, copy e direcionamentos que servirão como base para a criação das interfaces.

● Adaptar layouts para desktop e mobile, garantindo hierarquia visual, responsividade e boa experiência do usuário.

● Criar, manter e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e estruturas de design system quando necessário.

● Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes de diferentes segmentos, como bancos, fintechs, SaaS, e-commerce e geração de leads.


Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:

● Experiência sólida com UI Design, especialmente para sites e landing pages.

● Domínio avançado de Figma, incluindo componentes, Auto Layout e protótipos navegáveis.

● Portfólio online com projetos de UI Design (item indispensável no processo seletivo).

● Boa base em UX/UI Design, com foco em clareza, usabilidade e simplificação de problemas complexos.

● Experiência ou familiaridade com design systems e organização de componentes.

● Capacidade de executar com qualidade a partir de orientações claras, mantendo criatividade, organização e alinhamento com o time.

● Autonomia, senso de responsabilidade, comprometimento com prazos e boa gestão de demandas.

● Boa comunicação e abertura para dar e receber feedbacks.


Diferenciais desejáveis:

● Experiência prévia com projetos de CRO, testes A/B ou otimização de conversão.

● Conhecimento em Photoshop e Illustrator.

● Uso de ferramentas de IA no processo de criação ou edição de imagens.

● Experiência na criação de sites e landing pages do zero no Figma.

● Interesse genuíno por tendências de design e evolução constante do repertório visual.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Customer Success Specialist. You will own the long-term success, retention, and expansion of active customers. This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Own and manage ongoing customer relationships post-onboarding via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Conduct regular account performance and campaign reviews
  • Analyze metrics (deliverability, response rates, conversion signals, etc)
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Advise customers on campaign optimization, list strategy, volume, and cadence
  • Act as a trusted partner focused on ROI and lead outcomes
  • Identify expansion opportunities aligned with customer growth (users, volume, add-ons)
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or churn risk - escalate and resolve
  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience on customer insights
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

Senior SAP ABAP Developer (IBP / Finance Focus)

Seeking an experienced Senior SAP ABAP Developer to support its global IBP (Integrated Business Planning) implementation across Europe, North and South America. The consultant will replace an outgoing developer and play a key role in building and maintaining interfaces, enhancements, and integrations within the SAP ECC environment.

  • Experience supporting international, multi-region SAP environments
  • Excellent English communication and team collaboration skills


Nice to Have


  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA (awareness level acceptable) Not mandatory
  • Previous experience in manufacturing / industrial sectors

title: Partnership Analyst
description:
Job Description


At Pluria Global , we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click . Unlock potential through real connections.


Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations . We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia .


At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.


‍ We achieve this by bringing together three forces:

  • A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network.
  • Bottom-up coordination , enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals.
  • Top-down intelligence , delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions.


This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth .


Some numbers that back us up:

  • Global presence in over 10 countries
  • More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide
  • 20% month-over-month growth
  • A global team of 30+ people
  • 100% remote and multicultural team

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:

  • Support and enhance the client's existing React Native mobile application as part of a unified team delivering cross-platform experiences
  • Balance iterative MVP delivery with scalable, maintainable engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in front-end engineering with React.js and TypeScript
  • Proven track record delivering web applications using React.js, Next.js, and TailwindCSS
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Exposure to data visualization tools, such as D3.js, Recharts, or Mapbox
  • Experience using AI tooling, such as Cursor and CoPilot
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience working with React Native and cross-platform design systems
  • Experience with shadcn UI
  • Familiarity with Supabase or similar backend-as-a-service tools
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as D3.js, Recharts, or Mapbox


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP
