title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Human resources manager (middle level)
description:
About the Job
Turn Key is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our Turn Key team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U. S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, Yipit Data, Work Ramp, and Bell Xcel.
We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.OurHR Managerwill take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.Joining our team you will be focusing on
Working as an integral part of the Turn Key HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.Required Skills
A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
Client-facing experience
Advanced level of English
Great interpersonal and influencing skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Experience with HRIS
Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
applications
Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
Good level of emotional intelligence
Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
Learning agility
Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workloadPersonal competencies
Growth Mindset
Proactive and enthusiastic
Cultural Competence
Initiative and creativity
Achievement drive and optimism
Can-do attitude
Interpersonal and Communication Skills
Analytical and Problem-Solving SkillsWhy You Should Work at Turn Key
We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule

Fully Remote work

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
A Artha Growth Studio está em expansão e buscamos um(a)Editor(a) de Vídeospara integrar nosso time.Procuramos alguém com ritmo, visão estratégica de conteúdo e capacidade de transformar ideias em vídeos que geram retenção, autoridade e crescimento.A Artha Growth Studio trabalha com diferentes formatos de conteúdo, de vídeos dinâmicos para redes sociais até criativos avançados, materiais corporativos e projetos para o mercado imobiliário.Por isso, buscamos um(a)Editor(a) de Vídeoque possa atuar noestilo de edição em que mais se identifica.Você não precisa dominar tudo.Queremos pessoas que sejam muito boasno que já fazem bem.Sobre o trabalho
Você poderá atuar em diferentes tipos de projetos, como:
• Edição dinâmica de vídeos para You Tube, Reels, Shorts e Tik Tok.
• Criativos de marketing, VSL e materiais comerciais.
• Vídeos corporativos e institucionais.
• Projetos com motion, VFX ou 3 D, especialmente em conteúdos imobiliários e empreendimentos.Responsabilidades
• Edição de vídeos curtos e longos para redes sociais.
• Criação de cortes dinâmicos, legendas, transições e ritmo engajador.
• Adaptação de um vídeo-base para múltiplos formatos.
• Participação na construção da linha editorial e evolução do estilo visual da agência.
•Manter a qualidade e consistência do material da agência.
• Organização de arquivos, prazos e entregas.
•Comunicação clara com o time.
• Entrega consistente dentro dos prazos combinados.Requisitos
• Experiência no estilo de edição que deseja atuar.
• Portfólio obrigatório.
• Domínio da ferramenta que você usa.
• Capacidade de criar vídeos com alta retenção (timing, cortes, velocidade).
• Vontade real de crescer junto com a agência.Inglês e Espanhol intermediário é diferencial (trabalhamos também com clientes internacionais).Diferenciais
• Motion básico.
• Experiência com anúncios ou VSL.
• Experiência com 3 D, CGI ou VFX.Formato de trabalho
• PJ
• Remoto
• Remuneração por demanda ou mensal (dependendo da carga de projetos).

title: Indirect tax manager
description:
About Us:
Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.We are seeking a proactive and experiencedTax BPto support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.Job description
The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.Desired profile
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
Knowledge in Tax reform;
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;Language:
Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

title: Client services, interpretation (language services | research | due diligence | remote)
description:
About Us
Cadence ( ) is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.Key Responsibilities
You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen onour careers page.You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.The JobYou will manage multiple projects per day.Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).Here’s how you will interact with a project:Scoping
You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs
You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project
Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing
You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied
Key RequirementsBachelor’s degree in a related field
Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plusWorking Hours & LocationThis is afully-remote rolewhere you can work from home ( WFH )
You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.
Estamos em busca de umMECÃNICO INDUSTRIAL Cpara a região deLIMEIRA/SÃO PAULO.
#Vem Ser AgropalmaDescrição Breve do Cargo:
Realizar manutenção preventiva e/ou corretiva em compressores de ar, trocadores de calor, sistemas de vapor e condensado, bombas centrifugas, helicoidais e dosadoras;
Recolocar vedações das placas do filtro, desmontando partes mecânicas, conjuntos e subconjuntos, substituindo peças, efetuando a montagem dos equipamentos, verificando o funcionamento dentro dos padrões preestabelecidos;
Participar da realização de serviços de manutenção de maior grau de complexidade; efetuando a desmontagem, substituição de peças e montagem de conjuntos e subconjuntos;
Realizar correções de baixo rendimento, removendo, limpando e recolocando placas de filtros, trocando anéis de vedação e fazendo ajustes.Instrução
Ensino Médio Completo e Curso técnico em Mecânica/Mecatrônica;Desejável
NR-35, NR-33;
Experiência de 6 meses em funções semelhantes.Localidade
Limeira/SP
Americana/SPNossa Empresa
Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

title: Msp delivery specialist (bilingual english | portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group
Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.Summary
Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.Job Description
Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
Utilize and provide training on MSP tool such as Beeline and applications including Excel, Word, and Power Point.
Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
3–5 years of experience inMSP operations, or contingent workforce management.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Power Point, Word) and experience withBeeline
Bilingual Competency acrossEnglish and Portuguese
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.Why Join Pinnacle Group?
At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.

description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.
Estamos em busca de umMECÃNICO INDUSTRIAL Cpara a região deLIMEIRA/SÃO PAULO.
#Vem Ser AgropalmaDescrição Breve do Cargo:
Realizar manutenção preventiva e/ou corretiva em compressores de ar, trocadores de calor, sistemas de vapor e condensado, bombas centrifugas, helicoidais e dosadoras;
Recolocar vedações das placas do filtro, desmontando partes mecânicas, conjuntos e subconjuntos, substituindo peças, efetuando a montagem dos equipamentos, verificando o funcionamento dentro dos padrões preestabelecidos;
Participar da realização de serviços de manutenção de maior grau de complexidade; efetuando a desmontagem, substituição de peças e montagem de conjuntos e subconjuntos;
Realizar correções de baixo rendimento, removendo, limpando e recolocando placas de filtros, trocando anéis de vedação e fazendo ajustes.Instrução
Ensino Médio Completo e Curso técnico em Mecânica/Mecatrônica;Desejável
NR-35, NR-33;
Experiência de 6 meses em funções semelhantes.Localidade
Limeira/SP
Americana/SPNossa Empresa
Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.Requisitos e qualificações:Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
Domínio dos softwares Auto CAD e Sketch Up;
Pacote Office avançado;
Power BI será um diferencial;
Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.Local de Trabalho:Boulevard Shopping Feira de Santana

description:

Ter mentalidade de crescimento, identificando desafios e oportunidades de negócio e resolvendo-os por meio de análise e mineração de dados.

title: Ps systems engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U. S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.Key Responsibilities

Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.

Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.Skills & Experience
3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.

title: Software engineer (murex)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilledMurex Developerto join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins asfully remote , with the expectation ofrelocation to Portugalafter an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of theMurex MX.3platform.Responsibilities
Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations withinMurex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and Mx ML Exchange interfaces.
Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.Required Qualifications
Hands-on experience withMurex MX.3(configuration, development, or integration).
Solid knowledge ofDatamart, Mx ML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
Strong programming skills:Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
Strong English communication skills.
Willingness and eligibility torelocate to Portugalafter the initial remote period.
Nice-to-Haves
Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
Knowledge of Dev Ops methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
Familiarity withAgile/Scrum.
Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.
Desired Profile
Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.
What We Offer
Remote work during the initial phase.
Support and guidance for futurerelocation to Portugal.
Flexible working hours.
Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) full stack sênior (java)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software e capacidade técnica para atuar em projetos desafiadores e escaláveis.Missão do cargo
Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções com qualidade, usabilidade, desempenho e inovação, dentro dos prazos acordados, com supervisão mínima; tendo como foco a evolução da gestão em nossos clientes.Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!
Que tal se juntar ao nosso time e embarcar nessa jornada com a gente?Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesInterpretar requisitos funcionais criando vínculos entre estes e as modificações necessárias na solução;
Definir requisitos não-funcionais inerentes ao atendimento das necessidades de cada projeto, levando em conta todos os níveis lógicos da solução (camadas de apresentação, aplicação, banco de dados, etc);
Propor e desenvolver soluções para problemas que envolvam as áreas da Ciência da Computação e/ou Engenharia de Software;
Definir e desenvolver estratégias de integração com serviços e aplicações de terceiros;
Estimar custos e prazos para o desenvolvimento/manutenção da solução;
Negociar com clientes internos acerca de requisitos, recursos, custos e prazos de projetos e ajustes nas soluções/ferramentas;
Negociar com clientes externos acerca de requisitos, recursos, custos e prazos de projetos e ajustes nas soluções/ferramentas;
Escrever código legível, manutenível e robusto que atenda totalmente os requisitos funcionais e não-funcionais do projeto, sempre atento aos padrões utilizados pela empresa, garantindo a qualidade e funcionamento do que foi criado ou modificado;

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

description:

They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.Skills & Experience

Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.

Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.

title: Sr. technical customer success analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst
Business Unit: Graphic Communications
Location: Brazil, RemoteGraphic Communications( a CAI Division)is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries.Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy thatGraphic Communicationssucceeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at aSr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to theSr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.
In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.Key Responsibilities
Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities
Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify Java Script or API failures.
Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or c URL.
Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP. NET-based applications and related components.
Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.Experience Requirements
Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
ERP/MIS background preferred.
Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.

title: Graphic designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!Yeah, you heard that right.Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!Key Responsibilities
Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.Qualifications
Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
Proficiency in Microsoft programs (Power Point and Word)
Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as Chat GPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
A working level of written and spoken EnglishOur operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Especialista azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.Oportunidade: Especialista Azure
A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataformaMicrosoft Azure. A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase emAzure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.Responsabilidades
Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou Express Route.
Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.
Requisitos Técnicos
Domínio comprovado emAzure Network(mandatório).
Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.Contratação CLT
Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.O que oferecemos?· Contratação CLT;
· Vale Refeição;
· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
· Auxílio creche;
· Convênio com Farmácia;
· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
· Seguro de Vida.O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

title: Customer operations specialist
description:
SummarySphere is revolutionizing global money movement by building modern financial rails with digital dollars, making transactions simple, affordable, and accessible worldwide. Through our frontend applications, APIs, low-level bank messaging optimizations, and liquidity infrastructure, businesses in emerging markets can send money across borders at scale — without depending on foreign capital or simply speaking the right languages. We combine frontier technology like stablecoins and zero-knowledge proofs with traditional banking, payments, and foreign exchange infrastructure to make global payments settle in minutes.We’re a Seed+ startup globally distributed across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Portugal, and the Caribbean. We’ve processed over $1 B in payments volume and are backed by some of the best high-frequency trading and venture firms in the world, including TCG, Jump, Hudson River Trading, and Coinbase; as well as angels from companies like Stripe, Pay Pal, Brex, Visa, Revolut, Grab, Solana, Circle, and JPMorgan Chase. Our team has previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world’s leading companies (Coinbase, Vanguard, Franklin Templeton, Chainalysis, Wells Fargo) as well as at startups and accelerators like YCombinator. We’re spending the best years of our lives building Sphere, driven by a shared belief in our mission to enhance human prosperity through cutting-edge technology, creating a modern SWIFT for the 21st century and beyond.Key ResponsibilitiesManage the onboarding lifecycle of our enterprise customers, serving as their key liaison and ensuring timely setup
Support customers in navigating our Anti-Money Laundering requirements, including Know-Your-Customer and enhanced due diligence checks
Drive post-setup customer success with our enterprise customers, helping them unlock the full value of our offerings
Build out and manage a robust, multi-channel customer support function (email, chat), to deliver quick and effective resolutions to customer inquiries
Work closely with Sales & Product teams to transition customers to new product offerings or vendors
Proactively gather and synthesize customer needs and feedback, identifying opportunities for product/UX improvementsRequirementsStrong verbal and written communication skills in English and either Spanish or Portuguese
Excels at multi-tasking and rapid context switching in fast-paced environments
Demonstrated sense of ownership and strong project management & Organizational skills
Analytical, with a proactive approach to problem-solving
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skillsNice to havesPrior experience in a customer success, customer onboarding or customer-facing role
Prior experience in Compliance, Payments or Web3
Knowledge of SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, wire transfers, and other global payment networks.
Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) processes, currency conversions, and multi-currency settlement
Open to working flexible hours, and extended shifts, to meet business needsWhy Join Us?After years navigating the idea maze, we’ve stumbled on a previously unexplored path to exponentially boost human prosperity and make the world a fairer place. Join us in making a global impact, particularly in emerging regions that are just starting to connect.
Have executive level impact, responsibility, and upside in an early-stage startup that has found initial product-market fit and has been growing more than 100% per month over the last year.
Work on some of the hardest problems in the world, leveraging frontier technology in cryptography and distributed systems to modernize payments infrastructure from 1959.
Unlock exceptional growth and learning opportunities in an environment that champions ownership, ambition, and innovation.
Join as an early employee and help us define a world-class culture of collaboration, rationality, low ego/status, customer obsession, and output. There are rare learning opportunities, and you’ll be joining just as we start to scale.

title: Pessoa cientista de dados - vaga afirmativa para pessoas lgbtqiapn+

Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar.Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver.Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
Atuarem toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
Popularizartermos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
Priorizarsuas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas
O que nós estamos procurando:

title: Director of salesforce implementation
description:
Position OverviewThe Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.Key ResponsibilitiesTeam Leadership and Management
Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.Project and Delivery Oversight
Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction
Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.Operational Excellence
Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.Cross-Department Collaboration
Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.QualificationsRequired
7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.Preferred
Salesforce certifications.
Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
Flexible remote work environment.
Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction
Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.Operational Excellence
Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.Cross-Department Collaboration
Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.QualificationsRequired
7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.Preferred
Salesforce certifications.
Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
Flexible remote work environment.
Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.
